source_snapshot.procedure: Run `ipmitool mc selftest` in-band and via lanplus OOB, then check result data.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 5 attended/5 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; preserves both commands but uses insecure/inline credentials and leaves output interpretation to the user.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE/LOW; requires same-controller proof, protected transport, complete per-path evidence and decoded self-test status.

old_problem: The accepted result decoder and proof that IB and OOB reach the same controller were absent. Shell success alone cannot distinguish passed, not implemented, corrupted/inaccessible data or fatal hardware error, and the DeepSeek transport exposes credentials.
disposition_reason: IPMI 2.0 section 20.4 defines Get Self Test Results and standard status values 55h, 56h, 57h and 58h; ipmitool implements `mc selftest` using that command and decodes the 57h detail bits. Thus the core oracle is authoritative. ED-03/15/20 permit endpoint/device identity and an approved multi-MC exception to remain project configuration.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2228, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2229 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00012-V001 / 9cdef6595d271228 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.

Intel IPMI 2.0 section 20.4 defines Get Self Test Results as callable while ready and status 55h=all tests passed, 56h=not implemented, 57h=corrupted/inaccessible data/devices with detail bits, and 58h=fatal hardware error.
The official ipmitool implementation sends Application NetFn Get Self Test and treats 55h as passed while decoding non-healthy codes; command exit alone is not the health oracle.
Prove the host in-band interface and OOB address identify the same BMC using GUID/device ID/firmware, or use a signed multi-MC relationship.
Run one read-only query per path with trusted host identity and protected credentials; preserve stdout, stderr, exit, timestamp and decoded status/detail.
Compare protocol completion, controller identity and decoded result across paths; a valid non-healthy response is evidence but not PASS.
Do not reset BMC, clear SEL, write raw commands or retry to force a healthy result.
No IB/OOB query, SSH/login, reset, log clear, retry or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: IPMI Get Self Test Results through correlated in-band and out-of-band paths
test_case.purpose: Verify that the intended same BMC supports the standard IPMI Get Self Test Results operation through IB and authenticated lanplus OOB, returning consistently decoded controller health.
required_package: ipmitool plus verified IB device/interface and protected OOB session
SUT/BMC firmware, device ID/GUID and same-controller or approved multi-MC mapping
IPMI 2.0 Get Self Test Results decoder including 55h/56h/57h detail/58h
Approved cipher policy and secret-safe trusted transport
test_case.test_command: Identify and correlate the IB and OOB management controllers, then run `ipmitool mc selftest` once through the verified IB path and once through protected lanplus OOB. Capture complete stdout/stderr/exit/timestamps, decode the standard response/status/detail for each path, and compare controller identity and results without any reset or write.
test_case.expected_result: Both paths reach the intended controller relation, return successful protocol completion and the approved healthy self-test result (normally 55h/all tests passed), with equivalent decoded results and no transport or controller error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires identity correlation, successful completion and approved healthy decoded result on both paths. 56h not implemented, 57h corruption/inaccessibility, 58h fatal error, transport failure, malformed output or unexplained path divergence is not PASS; report exact status/details for engineer verdict. Missing identity mapping blocks execution, not review.
safety_gate: Verify IB/OOB controller identity and protected transport before querying.
Read-only `mc selftest` only; no raw write, reset, power action, threshold/FRU mutation or SEL clear.
One query per path; stop on wrong controller, unsupported/malformed response or divergence without corrective retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, SUT/BMC firmware, device ID/GUID and endpoint correlation
Complete redacted IB and OOB stdout/stderr/exit/timestamps
Per-path protocol completion plus decoded 55h/56h/57h-detail/58h result and comparison
test_case.recovery: No state change is expected. On transport, identity or health anomaly, preserve both paths' evidence and stop; do not reset the BMC, clear logs or rerun to change the result.

source_conflict.reason: The source consistently requires the standard self-test through IB and OOB; identity correlation is a prerequisite, not a conflict.

blocked.reason: The standard command and authoritative status oracle are available; endpoint mapping is parameterizable.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: IB device/interface and OOB BMC address; device ID/GUID same-controller mapping or approved multi-MC relation; ipmitool/cipher/transport bindings and project definition of acceptable not-implemented behavior if any.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED USING AUTHORITATIVE IPMI SELF-TEST STATUS; PROJECT ENDPOINT MAPPING REQUIRED; NO QUERY, LOGIN, RESET, LOG CLEAR, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: BMC/IPMI owner and platform management-topology owner
pending.unlock_condition: Bind and verify both paths to the intended controller relationship and protected access; absence blocks execution but not review resolution.

external_authorities.authority: Intel Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev.1.1, section 20.4 Get Self Test Results
external_authorities.application: Defines command availability, response layout and 55h/56h/57h/58h meanings.
Confirms `mc selftest` sends the standard request and decodes passed/not-implemented/corrupted/fatal results and 57h detail bits.

project_authority: BMC/topology owner signs IB/OOB controller mapping and cipher/access binding; end engineer owns health verdict.
